description: #195, the green twin of m28 and the mutation test run the other way round: here the FALLBACK would be red and the declaration is green, so a `pass` can only have come from `integration_baseline`. The profile's `baseline` is `cat cmate-worker-ok`, whose marker the dispatch harness writes into each worker worktree (`worktree_files`) and which the throwaway merged checkout therefore does NOT have; `integration_baseline` is `cat cmate-verify-ok`, the marker that checkout does have. So the workers verify green on `baseline`, and a merge runner that re-ran `baseline` after the merges would report integration_verify_failed. It reports pass, with `source: integration_baseline` — which is the half m28 cannot show: that a GREEN integration verification also says which set produced it, since a silent second baseline hides in the green reports, not the red ones.
